Mini donut chart

Source: R/mini-charts.R
shad_mini_donut.Rd

A ring showing a handful of parts of a whole, with an optional label in the middle. Like shad_sparkline() it is plain SVG painted with the theme's chart tokens, so it follows dark mode and preset switches in CSS.

Usage

shad_mini_donut(
  values,
  colors = 1:5,
  size = "6rem",
  thickness = 0.28,
  center = NULL,
  track = TRUE,
  label = NULL,
  class = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

values

A numeric vector of non-negative parts. They are shown in proportion to their sum, so they need not add to 1 or 100.

colors

Chart-token indices or CSS colours, recycled across the segments. Defaults to chart tokens 1–5.

size

CSS diameter (default "6rem").

thickness

Ring thickness as a fraction of the radius (default 0.28). 1 gives a pie.

center

Optional content for the middle of the ring (a value, a percentage, a tag).

track

If TRUE (default), draw the muted background ring that shows through when the segments do not fill it.

label

Accessible name. NULL (default) marks the chart decorative.

class

Extra CSS classes.

...

Extra attributes for the root <div>.

Value

A <div> wrapping an SVG.

Details

Segments are drawn as dashes on a single circle, which is why there is no path arithmetic here and why the ring stays perfectly round at any size.

See also

shad_sparkline()

Other shadshiny dashboard: shad_chart_container(), shad_sparkline(), shad_timeline(), shad_timeline_item(), shad_value_box()

Examples

shad_mini_donut(c(62, 24, 14), center = "62%")
#> <div class="shad-donut" style="width:6rem;height:6rem;">
#>   <svg class="shad-donut__svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-hidden="true">
#>     <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="39.06" fill="none" stroke="var(--shad-muted)" stroke-width="21.88"></circle>
#>     <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="39.06" fill="none" stroke="var(--shad-chart-1)" stroke-width="21.88" stroke-dasharray="152.17 93.27" stroke-dashoffset="0"></circle>
#>     <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="39.06" fill="none" stroke="var(--shad-chart-2)" stroke-width="21.88" stroke-dasharray="58.9 186.53" stroke-dashoffset="-152.17"></circle>
#>     <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="39.06" fill="none" stroke="var(--shad-chart-3)" stroke-width="21.88" stroke-dasharray="34.36 211.08" stroke-dashoffset="-211.08"></circle>
#>   </svg>
#>   <div class="shad-donut__center">62%</div>
#> </div>
